tool.name: InsertMolecules
tool.description: : Wrapper of the GROMACS insert-molecules module.

param.name: input_insert_gro_path
param.label: input GRO,PDB file
param.help: Path to the GRO file of the molecule to insert. Format: [input].[format]

param.name: input_gro_path
param.label: input GRO,PDB file
param.help: Path to the GRO file of the existing structure to insert into. If not provided, the molecules are inserted into an empty box defined by the box property. Format: [input].[format]

param.name: input_positions_dat_path
param.label: input DAT,TXT file
param.help: Path to the DAT file with the predefined insertion trial positions (three columns x y z in nm, displacements from the position of the molecule to insert). Format: [input].[format]

param.name: outname_output_gro_path
param.label: output GRO,PDB name
param.help: Path to the output GRO file Format: [output].[format]

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: nmol
param.label: nmol
param.help: Number of extra molecules to insert. Ignored if input_positions_dat_path is provided: one molecule is inserted per position.

param.name: box
param.label: box
param.help: Box size in nm as three floats ie "5.0 5.0 5.0". Mandatory if input_gro_path is not provided; if both are provided, a new box is placed around the input structure before the insertions.

param.name: tries
param.label: tries
param.help: Number of insertion attempts per molecule (nmol * tries attempts are made before giving up).

param.name: seed
param.label: seed
param.help: Seed for random number generator (0 means generate a random seed).

param.name: radius
param.label: radius
param.help: Default van der Waals distance in nm, used for atoms not found in the vdwradii.dat database.

param.name: scale
param.label: scale
param.help: Scale factor to multiply the van der Waals radii from the vdwradii.dat database.

param.name: dr
param.label: dr
param.help: Allowed displacement in nm in x y z from the positions in the input_positions_dat_path file.

param.name: rot
param.label: rot
param.option: xyz - random rotation around all axes
z - random rotation around the z axis

param.name: gmx_lib
param.label: gmx_lib
param.help: Path set GROMACS GMXLIB environment variable.

param.name: binary_path
param.label: binary_path
param.help: Path to the GROMACS executable binary.
